PingMoney

The context.

PingMoney combines a customer-facing Angular application with Laravel backend APIs and external payment providers. My work centered on improving how those layers communicate and how transactions behave through the payment lifecycle.

My contribution.

  1. Support Laravel backend APIs consumed by frontend and mobile applications.
  2. Integrate and maintain pay-in and payout gateway connections and partner APIs.
  3. Improve transaction-processing workflows, API responses, and integration error handling.
  4. Support partner communication, production troubleshooting, and payment-flow issue resolution.
  5. Contribute across B2B/C2C platform capabilities and ongoing product development.

The result.

  • Stronger integration between customer experiences and payment-provider workflows.
  • Practical full-stack support across a market-specific fintech platform.
Integration quality is visible to customers even when the complexity stays behind the API.
